subject: The secret mistake vets warned me about
preview_text: I almost didn't share this. But the reviews from top experts changed my mind about everything.
body_paragraphs: I got a call last week from a pet health writer at a major magazine. She was doing a deep dive on canine obesity. She told me something that stopped me cold: most dog weight loss plans are built on outdated science. And the vets she interviewed said it's causing owners to make one critical mistake.

She shared her notes. The consensus from the experts was clear: sustainable weight loss isn't just about cutting calories. It's about nutrient-dense meals tailored to breed metabolism. That's the exact philosophy we built PupShape on. When she published her article, she featured our method as a 'vet-approved hack' that actually works with a dog's biology, not against it.

This is why the custom meal plan inside PupShape isn't a generic chart. It's the result of that same expert-backed approach. It dynamically adjusts not just calories, but the protein, fiber, and fat balance specifically for your dog's breed, age, and current condition.

Open the app right now and look at your dog's plan. See the science behind each recommendation. It's the difference between a diet and a sustainable, healthier life. P.S. The writer ended up using PupShape for her own senior lab. She just sent me a '15% weight loss' milestone photo. That's the real review that matters.
